name: James Muslow House
address: 6025 Arden Street, Shreveport, Caddo Parish, LA

location.how: the Google Earth search's pin for the address (its view labels '6025' there); the house itself is not visible on any public ortho (NAIP 2007 to 2023, 0.6 m) nor on Google's 3D view: tree canopy covers the lot, so the building centre could not be placed by hand

standing.source: public orthos us-naip-2007 to us-naip-2023; Google aerial and street-level views 2026-11-25
standing.note: Hidden by canopy from above in every view; the street-level picture shows only the planting along the street. Drawn in 2014 to 2015 (Peterson Prize 2015), so recent. The 2018 3DEP lidar over the pin has no building-classified points (BASIS-GEO-016). Usable for methods that read the appraisal (M0); not for any method that measures from above until the building is confirmed.

plan.north: down the sheet (arrow points to the sheet bottom, turned roughly 10-15 degrees toward the sheet's left); all directions here are sheet directions
plan.note: Start at the outside corner of the bedroom wing at the sheet's top-left (NW on the sheet), walk clockwise. The enclosed building is the bedroom wing (left), the family room, hall, mechanical, laundry and service porch (middle), and the dining, living, kitchen, breakfast room and foyer (right). The service porch is counted as enclosed: it is walled on all sides with a door to the 'family and servant entry', and the materials note lists vinyl-tile floor in it like the kitchen and laundry. The sheet-top side of the family/dining/living rooms is a steel window wall drawn about 2" outside the bedroom wing's north face line, and the living room's 1'-0" stone end wall projects about 3" past the bedroom wing's face; these jogs are scaled (13 px and 32 px at 75 px/ft) and are within the reading noise of the drawing's line weights (about 5 px). The stone walls between the family room and dining room (1'-0") and between the bedroom wing and family room (7 1/8") run on past the building as garden walls; the chain cuts across them at the building face. The entry garden wall (1'-0") east of the breakfast room is the breakfast room's exterior wall between the foyer's glass wall and the breakfast room's glass wall; the chain follows its outside (entry-court) face there. The stone wall between the kitchen/service porch and the carport is the service porch's exterior wall; the chain follows its outside (court) face down to the sheet-bottom wall line and cuts across it there. Every across-the-sheet position is printed (top string 28'-0 5/8", 7 1/8", 20'-10 1/4", 1'-0", 45'-6"; bottom string 28'-1 1/2", 9", 20'-7 1/2", 1'-0", 35'-0", 1'-0", 8'-6", 1'-0"; both total 96'-0") except the kitchen/breakfast partition (scaled). Up-the-sheet, only the bedroom wing (47'-11") and the living room's stone east wall (33'-9" to the wall's end, past the foyer) are printed; the foyer, breakfast and kitchen glass lines are scaled. The bedroom wing floor is about 1'-4" above the living-area floor (ramp up in the hall).

roof.note: Overhang left out on purpose: it is very uneven, so one number would misstate the roof. Scaled off the dashed roof outline on sheet 3 (75 px/ft): sheet-top (garden) eave 536 px = 7.15 ft beyond the bedroom wing face (about 7.05 ft beyond the living room's stone wall in section A-A at 150 px/ft); sheet-bottom eave 264 px = 3.5 ft beyond the bedroom wing and laundry wall, and about 17 ft beyond the kitchen/breakfast walls because the roof covers the courts and the covered walk; sheet-left rake 148 px = 2.0 ft; sheet-right rake about 0.1 ft (dashed line at the wall face, fascia drawn to about 0.75 ft). The roof outline is a plain rectangle about 98.2 x 58.6 ft (7364 x 4396 px), which agrees with the site/roof plan (about 98 x 56 ft scaled at 20 px/ft).
roof.derive_note: one low-slope roof over the house and its courts with very uneven overhangs

flags.note: The 96'-0" across-the-sheet overall is printed and the chain matches it exactly (96.0 ft), but no up-the-sheet overall of the wall outline is printed: 47'-11" is the bedroom wing only and 33'-9" runs to the end of a stone wall past the foyer. The chain's up-the-sheet extent (48.18 ft: 47'-11" plus the 0.26 ft the living room's stone wall stands past the bedroom wing) rests on two scaled jogs.
Overhang not given (see roof.note): sheet-top 7.15 ft, sheet-bottom 3.5 ft (17 ft over the courts), rakes 2.0 and about 0.1 ft. A single overhang would make roof_plan_sf and gutter_ft wrong.

Five up-the-sheet runs are scaled (foyer glass, breakfast glass, kitchen jog, the two sheet-top jogs) and one across run (breakfast room 14.75 ft); the kitchen run and the service porch run are derived from them. Footprint and perimeter are therefore scaled-tier. Enclosure judgement: the service porch is counted as enclosed; the carport, its store rooms and the courts are not.

Grade is not printed anywhere; eave and ridge above grade rest on a scaled floor-to-grade offset (0.45 ft at section A-A), which varies from about 0.45 to 0.75 ft on the garden side and is more on the motor-court side.
